description: He wears an opaque textured teal long coat with wide full sleeves over crossed-front dark brown underlayers. Rich gold floral and animal-motif woven borders frame the front opening, cuffs and hem, with larger gold animal motifs on the sleeves and lower panels. A broad dark teal-and-gold sash wraps the waist and has round gold ornamental clasps, studs and long hanging tassels. Dark patterned trousers are mostly hidden beneath the long robe. Black-brown leather boots with low heels and small gold decorations show below the layers. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
